comment: Live pump.fun coins used by the buyback LiteSVM tests (tests/buyback). Each coin's BondingCurve.creator and Pool.coin_creator equal its pump_fees sharing-config PDA (the shape SIJKA has after fee sharing); none is mayhem / cashback / holder-reward, creator_fee_bps = 0. The tests patch only the SharingConfig shareholder (-> our fee_inbox) and, where a scenario needs it, the fields named in the test. Chosen 2026-09-26 from mainnet: dead coins, so their state changes rarely.
